US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll Resigns Amidst Friction

US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll has submitted his resignation to President Trump. His departure follows months of friction, reportedly with Pete Hegseth. Driscoll's resignation leaves a vacancy at the top of the US military. The Washington Post opinion piece suggests Hegseth's choices impacted leadership and the military.
